shared_elements: single large anthropomorphic figure occupying most of the surface
garment or drapery rendered with incised parallel lines
circular disc or rosette motif on the figure
bands/belt-like horizontal divisions across the body
arms with bracelet-like or banded wrists
justification: Both surfaces present a single dominant anthropomorphic figure with a distinctive tall headdress, patterned garment and a circular disc/rosette element on the body, and in both the figure fills nearly the whole field. But the relationships and manner of depiction differ sharply: B shows a bearded winged genie in strict profile, kneeling and reaching towards stylised palmettes with a specific gesture, rendered in fine linear detail, while A is a frontal, blocky, schematic figure with no wings, no attendant motifs and no interaction with other elements.
